title: published manifest.json
description: Index a filesystem publisher writes into its destination, next to the files it publishes. It carries the contract version of every published file, including the array-shaped projects.json, which has nowhere to put a version of its own. Carries no timestamp and never indexes itself, so republishing identical data produces identical bytes.

schemaVersion.description: Output-contract version. Bumped only by a breaking change: a removed field, a retyped field, or a newly required field.

name.description: A plain file name in the destination: no directory part, and never the manifest itself.
